summary: New item range-slider: two thumbs on one track, the fill the flat --ui-bg-accent span between them. Everything visible is Slider's, read from Slider's own SLIDER_SIZE table and thumb class, and the browser test compares the two per size so they cannot drift. Three things differ: the value is a readonly [number, number] tuple; each thumb is its own input named by a REQUIRED startThumbLabel / endThumbLabel (aria-label — an aria-labelledby would outrank it); and the thumbs may meet but never cross (thumbCollisionBehavior none, minStepsBetweenValues). Only the moving or hovered thumb lifts. The readout (on by default) joins formatValue's ends with a spaced en dash and collapses equal ends. Probed: the drag test fails with Base UI's default `push` (end thumb shoved to 1990); the keyboard path cannot see the collision rule at all. Paper: https://app.paper.design/file/01KZ39A2BC286MT85M658NRR4R/p-Z-0 (Component --- Slider --- Revision / Variants / Dark / API, Behaviour, Tokens, Gaps).
